Not necessarily your best friend, or even a close friend. Just what are your basic requirements to consider someone a friend? Is it regular contact, emotional support, shared humor, common tastes, or something simpler?

Can you tell me why your "best friend" is your best friend? Can you tell me about a time you had to stop being friends with someone?
What makes someone a good friend?
We understand each other; the good and the bad. It's easy to appreciate someone who you understand thoroughly.

Fair weather friends are the worst. Try to weed them out. They are by nature insincere, and will bolt at the first sign of anything requiring trouble. Tell someone things are not looking good with your career if they stop returning calls they were not your friend. Tell them you may need surgery, same thing. It might be dishonest, but I would hate to have someone as backup who would never be there.

My best friend, and most loyal friend, is someone I stopped to help when things looked real bad for them. They are doing great again and people don't forget who is there to help when everyone else walks away. Well, as long as they are not sociopaths.

Also as you get older it gets much harder to make real friends.
They're nice to you. You enjoy each other's company. You're there for each other.

When they still write to you even when you didn't talk to them for months. When they talk more about you, and less about themselves. When they vouch for you even when you fucked up. When they hug you even in the front of world's end. When they bring food even when you don't want to eat. When they fight with you. When they go with you. When they battle with you. When they punch the cancer fuck out of your body by being with you. When they are strong so you can be weak. When the storm can't stop them and when the sunshine can't melt them.

Those are the good friends. And you know they are, without a single second thinking about it.
I like a friend who's comfortable with silence when we're together, someone who doesn't feel the need to make small talk.

I find a lot of the time it's telling your friends what they need to hear, not what they want to hear. Sometimes its the opposite.

There's a certain way to go about it.
Good friends will tell you when you are doing something improperly - they will tell you the truth, even if it hurts.
